summary: The public (no-login) GET /api/v1/system endpoint now also returns min_app_version 2.0.0 so mobile apps can tell users to upgrade; the server version is bumped from 3.1.0 to 3.2.0.

statements.why: Only adds a min_app_version block to an endpoint that was already public (systems_controller.rb skips require_login) and bumps the version constant; no data, permission or money impact.
True, but doesn't say the /api/v1/system response now includes min_app_version (2.0.0); also omits the version bump to 3.2.0 (lib/black_candy/version.rb) and the new min_app_version.rb.

misses.what: The server now tells mobile apps the minimum supported app version (2.0.0); apps older than that may refuse to connect or prompt users to update.
Server version bumped to 3.2.0, which is shown to clients by the public /api/v1/system endpoint (skip_before_action :require_login, which it already had).
